title: Dragable Cards
desc: Trello-style board for SwiftUI: long-press a card and drag it between columns.
long: A Trello-style board for SwiftUI. Long-press a card, drag it between columns, and watch the others slide out of the way as it snaps into place. Bring your own card view; the board only adds the motion: a lift with tilt and shadow, an empty slot where it will land, a near critically damped drop, auto-scroll at the edges and haptics.
steps: 1. Add the package in Xcode (File, Add Package Dependencies) or in Package.swift
2. Add the DragableCards product to your target, then import it
params: DragBoardState<Item>. The cards of every column. Create it with @StateObject.
Padding around the columns, inside the horizontal scroll. Default 16.
DragAppearance: the lifted card and the empty slot (scale 1.04, tilt 4°, shadow 12, corner radius 6).
DragTiming: long-press delay (0.15 s) and the lift, shuffle and drop springs.
(Int, [Item]) -> View. Drawn at the top of each column with its index and items.
(Item) -> View. Draws one card. The same view draws the floating copy while dragging.
After a card lands: item, old column, new column and index there. Call it directly on the DragBoard.
